g.text: Security group secform4strategy-tasks, on the ECS Fargate tasks
Inbound: no rules, nothing can connect in. Outbound: all.
The live Lambdas run outside the VPC

g.text: HTTPS to the public S3 endpoint: TLS + SigV4
The publisher reads only regional AWS services and internet APIs,
which IAM protects, not the network; nothing reaches it from
outside: only the schedule and the EventBridge rule invoke it.
